sources.title: CBC — Alturas 2026 district comparison
sources.enumerated_scope: The complete one-page season update; one literal cultivar name. District averages, shipper reports and company trials use different denominators.
sources.limitations: Shipper reports, trial results and district-average denominators differ; estimated weekly series and organic split are not independently verified market share. No exact publication day printed; September context comes from the Resources index. Bounded document only; no complete company portfolio, rights, traits, nursery roles or growing region approved. No publication day inferred from event/season or URL. No poster graphics imported as cultivar photographs.

names.portfolio_context: Alturas is named in the 2026 season update. The 20% acreage / 28% trays and 1.56x figures are publisher comparisons, not independently verified market share or a universal yield trait.

sources.limitations: Poster uses field codes only; mapping to Dunsmuir/CBC029, CBC030, CBC045 and CBC043 is in separate May handout and not approved. Keep trial protocols/years and grower value estimates separate; no current footprint, commercial release or photo inferred. No poster graphics imported as cultivar photographs.

names.portfolio_context: Literal field code in the Oxnard grower-trial poster. This poster does not name a cultivar or approve commercial release. The separate May handout pairs this code with Dunsmuir / CBC029; this poster prints only the field code. Check both originals before combining identities.
